free_tier.stated: free of charge while the Inference API remains in experimental status; two models, Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 and Qwen3.8-27B, each with a 262,144-token context and text plus image input; limits per API key are 4M input tokens and 100k output tokens per 60 s and 10 requests per 60 s
free_tier.notes: the vendor says it will email users before the experimental status changes; the model list changes during the experiment and GET /v1/models is definitive

tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client at https://inference.hetzner.com/api/v1; endpoints /v1/models, /v1/completions and /v1/chat/completions
chaining: Hetzner-hosted open-weight models behind a per-key ceiling of 10 requests per minute

limits.value: per API key: 10 requests per 60 s, 4M input tokens per 60 s, 100k output tokens per 60 s; HTTP 429 beyond any of them

identity_cost.detail: unverified at the vendor: the docs page names no sign-up requirement. A third-party tracker reports that minting a token needs a Hetzner account whose payment verification can include a card charge or other routes

reliability_note: experimental service offered as is: performance and availability are not guaranteed, no backups, and the model list can change without a fixed schedule
confidence_note: the rate limits and the free status are quoted from the vendor's docs page; the identity requirement is a third-party report because the key-minting page is a client-rendered application that could not be captured as text.

evidence.proved: the API is free while it stays experimental
evidence.quote: As long as the Inference API remains in experimental status, it is free of charge.

evidence.proved: per API key, 4M input tokens and 100k output tokens per 60 seconds
request-level limit of 10 requests per 60 seconds
Qwen3.8-27B is served with a 262,144-token context and image input

evidence.quote: Minting a token needs a Hetzner account; payment verification can include a card charge or other routes.
